scope: The pages from the fifteen-page audit not covered by the twenty-five highest-risk assertions.

packets.whatToLookFor: Whether NIH neuroethics guidance states a lifecycle for biological-material governance, and whether it addresses organoid or hybrid-system oversight specifically.

packets.publisher: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health
packets.whatToLookFor: Whether NCCIH states what meditation studies can and cannot establish, and any explicit limits on operationalising contemplative outcomes.
Whether the source addresses scaling effects on behaviour, which is currently an unresolved causal claim.
Whether the convention text supports the page's statements about intangible heritage and community categories, at the scope stated.
Whether TEI's critical-apparatus module supports the manuscript and textual-criticism claims, which are textual rather than historical.
The analysis stages, if a lawful route becomes available. Direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 and was not circumvented.
Whether the charters address provenance and chain of custody as the page states.
What the study measured, and its own stated limits on inference to intelligence or learning.

familyIndexRule: Family index pages must not imply evidence-backed status for a page whose state is structural or blocked. The index renders no evidence badge, so an unsupported page is not advertised as supported.
publicExposureRule: No private audit label, disposition, risk score or review rationale is rendered. The reader sees the page; the audit stays here.
noSilentRemoval: No public content was removed in this batch.
boundary: Packets say what to look for and what each source is expected to be able to establish. None asserts that a source will support anything.
